mapper.select:
/* SystemMngMapperVE.selectSubQnAList : 서브 문의사항(QnA) List */ SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;
SELECT T2.REFERENCE_NO , T2.SEQ_NO , T2.QANDA_TYPE , (SELECT NAME_${userLanguage} FROM TB_SMS_CODE_DETAIL WHERE ENT_CODE = T1.ENT_CODE AND GROUP_CODE = 'QUESTION_TYPE_VE' AND CODE = t1.QUESTION_TYPE) AS QUESTION_TYPE_NAME , T2.QUESTION_SEQ_NO , T2.CONTENTS , T2.FILE_CONTENT_TYPE , T2.ENT_CODE , CASE WHEN T2.FILE_TEMP_NAME IS NOT NULL AND LTRIM(RTRIM(T2.FILE_TEMP_NAME)) != '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS FILE_SHARE , T2.REGISTER_USER_ID , T2.REGISTER_DATE_TIME , T2.UPDATE_USER_ID , T2.UPDATE_DATE_TIME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = T2.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = T2.REGISTER_USER_ID) AS REGISTER_USER_NAME , (SELECT USER_NAME FROM TB_SMS_USER WHERE ENT_CODE = T2.ENT_CODE AND USER_ID = T2.UPDATE_USER_ID) AS UPDATE_USER_NAME , T1.QUESTION_USER_TYPE , T1.TITLE , T1.QUESTION_TYPE , T1.FILE_CONTENT_TYPE AS ORIG_FILE_CONTENT_TYPE , T1.FILE_PATH AS ORIG_FILE_PATH , T1.FILE_TEMP_NAME AS ORIG_FILE_TEMP_NAME , T1.FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME AS ORIG_FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , FS.REFERENCE_NO_ID AS FILE_REFERENCE_NO_ID , FS.SEQ_NO AS FILE_SEQ_NO , FS.FILE_NAME AS FILE_ORIGINAL_NAME , FS.FILE_NAME_REMOTE AS FILE_TEMP_NAME , FS.FILE_PATH_REMOTE AS FILE_PATH FROM TB_ECM_QANDA_DETAIL T2 INNER JOIN TB_ECM_QANDA T1 ON T1.REFERENCE_NO = T2.REFERENCE_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT fs.REFERENCE_NO_ID , fsf.SEQ_NO , fs.FUNC_JOB_NO , fs.FUNC_REFERENCE_NO , fsf.FILE_NAME , fsf.FILE_NAME_REMOTE , fsf.FILE_PATH_REMOTE FROM TB_COM_FILE_SHARE fs LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_COM_FILE_SHARE_FILE fsf ON fs.REFERENCE_NO_ID = fsf.REFERENCE_NO_ID ) FS ON FS.FUNC_JOB_NO = T2.REFERENCE_NO AND FS.FUNC_REFERENCE_NO = CAST(T2.SEQ_NO AS VARCHAR) WHERE T2.REFERENCE_NO = #{referenceNo}
/* SystemMngMapperVE.getDetailCount : 문의사항(QnA) - Detail Count */ SELECT COUNT(*) FROM TB_ECM_QANDA_DETAIL WHERE REFERENCE_NO =#{referenceNo}

/* SystemMngMapperVE.getOrderInfo : 오더정보조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 OD_JOB_NO ,BOUND ,BOUND_TYPE ,CUST_CODE_LV1 ,CUST_CODE_LV2 ,DELIVERY_CODE ,PIECES ,(SELECT MAX(SEQ_NO_ID) FROM TB_ECM_OD_MULTI WHERE OD_JOB_NO = OD.OD_JOB_NO) AS MULTI_SEQ_NO_ID FROM TB_ECM_OD OD WHERE OD_JOB_NO = #{odJobNo}

/* SystemMngMapperVE.selectOdInfo : 멀티송장번호로 오더 정보조회 */ SELECT TOP 1 od.OD_JOB_NO , mul.SEQ_NO_ID FROM TB_ECM_OD od INNER JOIN TB_ECM_OD_MULTI mul ON od.OD_JOB_NO = mul.OD_JOB_NO WHERE mul.DELIVERY_NO = #{srchNo}
